verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the copy is scattered with nothing tying it together (three orphaned '100% Cotton' labels, a stray 'Order online:', $18 and $12 split from their products), two of the shirts are shrunk to thumbnails, the logo is tiny and floats away from its name, and the headline sits over the edge of the olive block. B keeps the headline as the clear focal point and keeps each product with its own name and price, but it does not hold together: the dark grey card is bigger than the other two so the three products are no longer equals, the shirt photos are small and jammed into the corners of their cards, the right edges don't line up, the gutters and margins are uneven, and the 'Order online:' line is cramped against the URL.
